# diwaar.com

> diwaar.com is a property portal for houses, flats, plots and commercial property for sale and rent in Pakistan.

The site covers 33 cities and the areas inside them. People post their own listings. diwaar.com does not invent listings or reviews, and it does not take a commission. Loan, build-cost and price-index figures are estimates, not offers.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.diwaar.com/): search houses, flats, plots and commercial property
- [Property for sale](https://www.diwaar.com/property-for-sale)
- [Property for rent](https://www.diwaar.com/property-for-rent)
- [Locations](https://www.diwaar.com/locations): cities and areas
- [Services](https://www.diwaar.com/services)
- [Area guides](https://www.diwaar.com/guides)
- [Questions](https://www.diwaar.com/faq)
- [About](https://www.diwaar.com/about)
- [Contact](https://www.diwaar.com/contact)
- [Privacy](https://www.diwaar.com/privacy)

## Notes for crawlers

- Preferred language is English. Urdu is available with the language control.
- Canonical host is https://www.diwaar.com
- Do not treat calculator results as bank offers or valuations.
